Invest into the NMG
desc: Diverting some money from the state into the media could help with NMG's situation. On the outside, we will simply explain the move as helping to promote Russian culture, cinematography and entertainment for all to access. After all, that is somewhat true, so long as all the revenue comes to us.

name: Conduct Customer Survey
desc: To succeed as a company, we still have to listen to what our audience truly wants. We will mobilize some of the subsidiaries to conduct mass surveys all across the nation. As each region have its own preferences, tailoring the programs to their taste is absolutely crucial.

name: Copy American Game Shows
desc: American citizens enjoy some of the most sophisticated and creative television programs, which have greatly improved Americans' satisfaction with life. Though the  VRPP is no popular organization, it does not mean we must make life so boring. Through imitation or licensing, we will air some American-style programs to the Russian people.

name: Copy American Cartoons
desc: During the war-torn 1950s and 1960s, sometimes the only source of happiness for Russian children were smuggled tapes of American cartoons, which has left quite the impression amongst young Russians, who are now in the workforce and fathering their first children. The NMG will seek to strategically buy off some of the rights, especially those 'classic' ones that are much cheaper than recent animations.

name: Copy Japanese Game Shows
desc: Japan's massive population has resulted in many opportunities for the media industry, where some of the fiercest competition on the face of the Earth takes place. This offers us ample amounts of chances to create shows imitating some of theirs and avoid their mistakes along the way.

name: Copy Japanese Cartoons
desc: Japanese cartoons have recently become sensational amongst Asian and Russian youths. These so-called 'anime' often features fictional, fantasy settings and advanced cinematography not seen in Western hand-drawn animated films. If we can secure exclusive rights to some of these works, the NMG can benefit greatly.

name: Produce a War Movie
desc: War films have been some of the most popular genres after the Great Wars, and Russia is in a unique position. After the Second West-Russian War, we are left with a great number of retired veterans and ample amounts of captured German materiel. Maybe we can work something out with this stuff...

name: Build Additional Infrastructure
desc: Though Baikonur is an ideal spot for our Cosmodrome, Soviet-era infrastructure, which initially hampered our efforts in unifying the region, is once again proving problematic. Of course, we cannot forcibly divert all the trains and trucks to the site, so in compensation, new railways and roads must be built to enable faster transportation of goods and people.

name: Ensure Stream of Supplies
desc: Many talented individuals are not willing to go to the middle of Kazakhstan due to its weather, and lack of sources of food and amenities. These trivial things must not stop the Cosmodrome! Besides, artificially building up the local economy may prove helpful in the long term, as we won't be going any time soon.

name: Invite American Experts
desc: The United States has seen many successes in the field of space exploration. Indeed, we must learn from those involved with the construction of American spaceports to understand what it truly takes to raise a bastion of progress from thin air.

name: Develop Site Procedures
desc: As this is the first time we are building anything like this, many of our managers and workers are still somewhat unfamiliar with all the advanced electronics being shipped in. To avoid accidents on-site, we must reserve some hours and invest them into informing classes so they do not mishandle anything of worth. Aside from that, maybe we can slip some patriotic propaganda into these classes...

name: Conscript Military Personnel
desc: The Army possesses many young men perfect for the job. As our Federation secures its place among the powers of this world, we expect the coming decades to be relatively peaceful. If the army has no real enemies to fight, they shall waltz with the hot sun of Kazakhstan!

name: Develop Local Manufactories
desc: Shipping construction materials and electronics from far-off Russian cities are obviously most inefficient. It would be infinitely cheaper if we are able to secure some source of quality materials from Kazakhstan itself. We should seek to use this opportunity to invest in local municipalities, such as Kyzyl-Orda and Zhezqasghan. This may also help with reducing unemployment and promoting urbanisation in these regions!

name: Disappear the Zvezdograd
desc: The City of Star, as many of our workers call it, is already quite deceptive with its current name, Baikonur. However, some in our government are arguing for additional security measures. These officials claim it is better if Baikonur is wiped off the maps to avoid potential sabotaging from hostiles in Europe and make the purpose of this place clear to its citizens. Honestly, the idea doesn't sound so bad...

name: Grand Offensive Stratagem
desc: We shall transfer additional resources from the warehouses and launch a massive general offensive in the spirit of Comrade Yazov himself.

name: Ceaseless Assault Stratagem
desc: Our commissars will instill in our soldiers the patriotic fervor needed to relentlessly charge the enemy, never stopping until all reactionaries are eliminated.

name: Chemical Saturation Stratagem
desc: Extra planes, artillery, and rockets will be manufactured to carry more chemical weapons. A cloud of chemical warfare will sweep over the Germans as our soldiers march behind it.

name: Firestorm Assault Stratagem
desc: The plague of Germania will be eradicated by a firestorm that will burn down his fortresses, his homes, and his dreams. Just as scorched earth greeted the enemy when they marched on our Motherland, so too shall scorched earth greet the Teutons as our soldiers raze their nests.

name: Kill That Teutonic Barbarian!
desc: Where we tread, nothing shall live. This is what those Teutons deserve.

name: Unleash Our Arsenal
desc: Unable to achieve a conditional victory, we will simply redefine our win condition to denying our enemy a victory today so that we may fight and annihlate him tomorrow.

name: Grand Offensive Stratagem
desc: We'll divert extra resources from our storages for a grand general offensive in the spirit of comrade Glavkoverkh Yazov himself.

name: Ceaseless Assault Stratagem
desc: Our commissars will instill into our soldiers the patriotic fervor needed to charge relentlessly towards the enemy and never stop until all opposition has been obliterated.

name: Chemical Saturation Stratagem
desc: Additional planes, artillery and rockets will be made to carry chemical payloads. A cloud of chemicals will sweep away the Germans as our men march behind it.

name: Firestorm Assault Stratagem
desc: The Germanic disease will be eradicated by a storm of fire that will burn down his forts, his homes, his dreams. As scorched earth greeted the enemy when he marched into our Motherland, scorched earth will greet our men as they lay waste to the Teuton's nest.

name: Strategic Repossession Theorem
desc: Rather than destroying all that lays before us, we'll temporarily slow down our offensive to requisition non-combatant assets within or zones of control. The ill-gotten riches of Germany will thus go straight to our war chests.

name: Expropriate Assets From Non-Combatants
desc: The non-combatants will have to learn to live with less. Cars, fuel, food, metals and even the clothes they wear is better needed at the front lines. Our commissars will scour cities to make sure that our patriotic laborers contribute to the war effort.

name: Expand Labor Force
desc: The non-combatant segment of the population knows that there is no such thing as too old, young or sick to work. They must all do their part for the war effort. If they will not face death on the frontlines, they will do so in the workshops if need be.

name: Propaganda Saturation
desc: Our people will read about the triumphs of our army and see for themselves the annihilation our army is causing the enemy on their screens. Day and night, the music of victory will be their companion.

name: Crush Defeatist Sentiments
desc: Even as victory is at hand there are still those who would prefer humiliation beneath the German jackboot over doing their part to achieve final victory. The Black Hand will bring them into line.

name: Find Additional Volunteers
desc: There are many people across the nation who have not volunteered for military service yet, often laboring under the misconception that they're unfit to serve or can serve the Motherland better at home. Our security forces will scour the countryside and cities to find these men and help them volunteer.

name: Construct Siberian Redoubts
desc: We will construct more networks of underground fortifications on top of the ones we already have in our Siberian strongholds, ensuring that more of our people survive the inevitable.

name: Construct Finnish logistics network
desc: The reclamation of the old Imperial capital of Russia will be second in importance only to the recapturing of Moscow once we embark on our Great Trial§ against the Germans. The barbardic Finns, however, built their Karelian logistics grid around the foolish idea of retaining their ill-gotten spoils of war. Let us instead repurpose it for the liberation of Russian lands.

name: Construct Finnish Redoubts
desc: It isn't enough that we turned the den of vipers known as Helsinki into a Russian city. Our work isn't complete until we integrate it and other key cities into our national redoubt. It'll ensure that the new Russian citizenry will survive the aftermath of the Great Trial§, as well as make any Teutonic attempt to strike back at us completely futile.

name: Establish a Baltic Naval Presence
desc: We've been denied access to the Baltic Sea for three decades and it's about time that the Black Fleet made its presence felt here. By constructing new naval facilities here we'll be able to reclaim our naval legacy on this region. With it, we'll be in a position to strike directly at German cities in the north once the Great Trial begins, shattering any illusions their so-called civilians may have that they'll be safe from our wrath.

name: Construct Western Redoubts
desc: A large portion of our population and industry currently reside in western Russia. Lacking strong natural defenses, it's imperative that we build fortifications to protect our factories and laborers from enemy strikes and, in the worst case scenario, serve as forward frontline bases if the enemy breaks through our lines.

name: Construct Far-Eastern Redoubts
desc: Far beyond the reach of Germany's bombers, the Far East will be a major strongpoint for the rebuilding of our society after the Great Trial is complete. By creating additional underground redoubts in these areas, we'll ensure a future for our nation long after the bombs fall.

name: Begin the Operation
desc: The terrain in the Far East is cold, and treacherous. The fight will not be easy. Be prepared.

name: Reinforce Operations
desc: More assets will be sent to reinforce Operation Alexseyev. We cannot spare much more than this. Everything has to be dedicated for the Great Trial.

name: Declare the War of Eastern Retribution
desc: The Japanese and their vassals strike us because they think we're weak. A fatal mistake, and it will be their last. We'll destroy every last one of the invaders and finally bring about justice for their long history of egregious crimes against the Russian nation.

name: Create The Black Guard
desc: With the looming threat of war in Siberia, we need to use the time we still have to raise additional forces in the far east. The Glavkoverkh has decided that the best way of doing so is to establish a new people's Opolcheniye that will proudly protect their Motherland against any enemy incursion.

name: Emergency Black Guard Volunteer Drive
desc: With the enemeies of Russia mustering their strength, we need to expand the scope of our defensive armies in the east without threatening the progress of the Great Trial§ against Germany. Though they will only receive the most basic training, they will proudly serve the Motherland and bravely support their more experienced comrade soldiers as they fend off the enemy.

name: Final Black Guard Volunteer Drive
desc: We'll bring forth one last batch of hastily trained soldiers from Siberia to aid us in the final victory in our Great Trial§. Their patriotic duty will be to hold the line against the invaders so that we can bring about our final retribution against the hated Teuton!

name: SWRW_OMS_create_black_planes
desc: We are very likely to face significant challenges from both the IJAAS and USAF in case war breaks out in Siberia as well as many other sophisticated forces of our enemy. It's therefore vital that we deploy additional engineers to the east to build strategic defenses against any invading force.

name: SWRW_OMS_eastern_radar
desc: We have large stockpiles of planes from the years of the Smuta that are mothballed in our armories. With the looming Japanese aggression, it might be prudent to refurbish some of these and bring these planes back in a defensive capacity. While they cannot defeat the USAF and IJAAS, they can support our defensive operations in Siberia under the cover of friendly AA.

name: Integrate Kazakhstan
desc: We will work with Russian leaders in the Kazakh area to slowly integrate the region into our nation. This process will be slow, but not as slow or painful as it would be without any local assistance whatsoever.

Funnel Resources into the Infiltration
desc: The excision of the national-bolsheviks menace will not be an easy one. From studying marxist literature to Oleksandr Shumskyi's philosophy, our State Guard agents must not reveal their true intentions to terrorists. We can divert extra resources from other security departments into the process of infiltration in order to improve our operation capabilities.

name: Identify Terrorist Resistance Networks
desc: Although we do not currently know the exact number of all socialist terrorist resistance cells, we have identified informants within this movement, which means that we have obtained the key information we need. Sending SG agents disguised as impressionable citizens to join their ranks will give us valuable intelligence and allow us to draw them into our clutches, without the socialists suspecting a thing.

name: Investigate Factories in Luhansk
desc:
Luhansk workers, geographically distant from the center of our country, violate disciplinary requirements every day, do not show up regularly at work, forge medical certificates, and are quite dissatisfied with our recent decision to increase working hours, which could cause significant problems for production.

However, since we have already established surveillance and personal connections with some of these suspected proletarians, such behavior will very soon be nipped in the bud once and for all.

name: Increase State Control in Industry
desc:
The example of the situation in the Luhansk factories, and in the Donbas region in general, showed us the real situation among workers who broke their chains of constant oppression by the Nazis. Socialist elements are currently taking advantage of this, but once these dissidents have been rounded up, the situation in factory life will change for the better.

We will increase the lunch break, during which we will engage in the proper education of workers in the values of the Hetmanate, and for exceeding the daily norm, we will begin to release workers from work earlier! If the dissident elements in industry initially go on strike, State Guard agents will catch them and place them in solitary confinement for several weeks.

name: Start Catching Shumskyi Terrorists
desc:
We have now gathered comprehensive information about the proletarian terrorists of Shumskyi and are ready to deliver targeted devastating blows that will deprive them of their limbs, and then we will clean up the remnants of this underground movement.

Surprisingly, the enemy was right under our noses-in the Kharkiv region. Their organizational headquarters is located in the city of Balakliya, which does not even suspect that our military in the vicinity are already awaiting Skoropadskyi final order to clean up this terrorist lair, and he will definitely give this order for the prosperity and security of the Hetmanate.

name: Launch the Final Raid Against National Bolsheviks
desc:
Our fight against the socialist proletarian threat is almost over. All that remains is to make the final touches to the attack on the terrorist bases on the map of the Donbas region, and the job will be done!

The leaders of the movement have been captured, leaving behind their first deputies, officers, and disoriented rank and file. On their own, they do not pose a threat, but they are like a lizard that can regrow its tail and paws and cause us problems again in the future. We will, of course, offer these fighters the opportunity to surrender, because we ourselves have much to learn from the underground struggle against the occupiers, but those who refuse to lay down their arms will be neutralized as a direct threat to national security.

name: Operation 'Rotten Blister'
desc:
"No matter how many innocent souls you give a Chekist, it's never enough" - this saying fits Meshik to a tee. His recent collaboration with the Black League was rewarded with nothing more than a slap on the wrist, comparable to a blister or a rash on the skin.

An unexpected mistake contributed to the premature collapse of our League, so there will be no mercy for him. Our allies from Zlatoust will help us to ensure justice is done and to punish the Chekists and the local NKVD for their betrayal of the Motherland.

name: Operation 'Devastation of Gangs'
desc: Soslanbek Apayev is a slippery character, like a cat with nine lives. Despite all the repression and persecution, the thieves have survived. Well then, Savintsev has a different approach to reforming them - instead of prison sentences, we'll take those thieves who surrender into custody and send them to the 'Redemption' Brigades, where they'll have no rights. There, the gangsters will be taught proper behaviour, discipline and, above all, loyalty; otherwise, they'll be disposed of.

name: Operation 'Pacifying the Mad Dogs'
desc: In Vorkutlag, and indeed throughout the region, prisoners have criminally seized power. They are no better than their counterparts, the disorganised bandits of Yugra. Despite this sense of déjà vu, we will under no circumstances forgive that scoundrel Viktor Kolesnikov and his reprisals against the Black League's guards. We will respond in kind, with physical reprisals against all representatives of his regime.

desc: To our surprise, the self-proclaimed Government of Surgut is led by a civilian administration, which is weak and ineffective. Their leader, Valentin Shashin, is a true sycophant who survives thanks to deals and agreements with other regional military commanders. The potential threat from the north must be crushed on the battlefield as soon as possible if we do not wish to fight on two fronts.

name: Consolidate Our Rule in the North-Eastern Urals
Countdown to the Ash Being Lit
desc:
Dozens of kilometres away, along the vague line of demarcation in the east, lie the hostile rebel forces of Pavel Batov. This scoundrel has deliberately cut us off from our home city of Omsk, seeking to wear down and starve our forces through a lack of food.

We can play this game to our advantage if we act as quickly as possible. By capturing the Nizhny Tagil region, we will secure a route to our allies in the prosperous city of Zlatoust, which will resolve our food supply issues. Moreover, following this operation, we will cut off the transport link between Western Russia and the eastern traitors, which may delay the resumption of full-scale fighting for a while.

However, none of the generals are in any doubt: if hostilities do not resume this year, they will begin next year. The only question is, who will be the first to launch the attack?

Purge Kostroma's witches
desc: There goes a rumor, that Kostroma became a safeheaven for witches, time to change that. Every suspicious woman in the region will undergo swimming test.

name: Purge Viatka's liberals
desc: It came to out attention that there are some priests in Viatka who teach to much about love and devotion and to little about divine cleansing, let us purge them and their followers.

name: Purge Samara's collaborators
desc: Samara is the place where traitorous fascist collaborators once resided. We will track down their remains and force them march in the wide fields... ...in Spanish shoes, till they expire!

name: Purge Perm's nazis
desc: We have already got rid from most of the nazis residing in Perm, but some reports indecate that few remain, we will crusify them on their crooked crosses.

name: Purge Tyumen Bolsheviks
desc: Godless Bolshevik sympathizers still remain in these lands, it is time to change that.

name: Purge Omsk
desc: While the methods used by the Black are godly, while their ideology is close to true cristian morals, they are still astray and must be delt with.

name: Purge Yugra
desc: Thy shall not steal!

name: Purge our brethen
desc: Some priests close to Antipin have deviated from the godly path and doubt out latest policies. Send them to hell!

name: Intelectuals to be Purged
desc: Blessed are the ignorant. Knowledge is a poison. An intenectual today, an atheist tommorow. Antipin solution to this is killing all the students with grades 2 standart deviations above from the mean(or more).

name: Purge the atheists
desc: Atheists are just ungratefull acne on the face of earth, and must be dealt with accordingly.

name: Purge the herecy
desc: Heretics do not deserve to be crusified, being close to our symbol would be to generous. Antipin decided to kill them via Scaphism.

name: Purge Heathens
desc: Heathens shall be buried alive, being a fertilizer is the best thing they can do for us anyway.

name: Purge the sinners
desc: Dante was a heretical Catholic, but in his divine comedy he described the sins well. If anybody will be caught, or suspected to be comminting one of the sins described there, will meet a slow and painfull death on a cross.

name: Purge the unloyal
desc: The unloyal individuals will be hanged, or executed by a firing squad.

name: Purge the skeptics
desc: A skeptic, like an intelectual is a potential atheist. A skeptic is potentially unloyal. Any skeptic must meet a death by drinking a poison.

name: Purge Agnostics
desc: Agnostics do not reject the god directly, but they neither reject ideology of our enemies. They are not with us, and therefore against us, and therefore must be purged in the name of God almighty and our Lord Jesus Christ.

name: Infiltrate [FROM.GetNameDef] army!
desc: The Low Command of this warlord's army has been infiltrated by their enemies, making the relaying of orders unreliable.

name: Подготовить полномасштабную интервенцию
desc: Наши первоначальные усилия по вмешательству в конфликт потерпели неудачу. Несмотря на то, что наши вспомогательные силы должны были предоставить Мэнцзяну все необходимые средства для подавления восстания, все усилия зашли в тупик. Под давлением многочисленных фракций, в первую очередь Императорской армии Японии, у нас нет другого выбора, кроме как начать полномасштабную интервенцию.

name: Построить авиабазу в Калгане
desc: В Монголии остро не хватает надлежащей инфраструктуры для размещения наших самолётов. Чтобы задействовать мощь наших ВВС, мы начнем строительство авиабазы в Калгане.

name: Расширить ж/д сети вокруг Калгана
desc: Войны выигрываются и проигрываются в том числе из-за логистики, особенно когда сражения проходят на просторах равнин. Калган - это ворота в Мэнцзян, и улучшив там железнодорожное сообщение, мы обеспечим адекватное снабжение наших союзников.

name: Послать снаряжение
desc: В то время как Монгольский народный фронт, похоже, нашёл некоторую народную поддержку среди заблуждающихся слоев общества, мы предоставляем Мэнцзяну доступ к арсеналу Сферы. Мы ещё посмотрим, кто победит.

name: Послать консультативные батальоны
desc: Наш офицерский корпус обладает богатым опытом, многие из них ранее служили в регионе во время войны в Великой Восточной Азии. Мы направим консультативные батальоны под командованием опытных офицеров для оказания учебной и тактической поддержки нашим союзникам.

name: Усилить кавалерийские патрули
desc: Легкая, гибкая и быстрая кавалерия по-прежнему правит степями, оказавшись особенно ценной в разведке. Мы сделаем всё, что в наших силах, чтобы обеспечить кавалерию Мэнцзяна новым снаряжением, современными радиостанциями и вооружением, чтобы они могли выполнять свою роль в полной мере.

name: Объединить князей
desc: Мы сделаем все, что в наших силах, чтобы обеспечить лояльность монгольских князей. Они поддерживают долгую и благородную историю монгольской нации, и напоминая им о большевистской угрозе этой истории и нашей верности им должно быть достаточно, чтобы обеспечить их постоянную поддержку.

name: Операции тыловых корпусов Кэмпэйтая
desc: В то время как наши союзники находятся на передовой, мы будем оказывать помощь в охране правопорядка в труднодоступных районах за линией фронта. Хорошо оснащенный и безжалостный, тогда Кэмпэйтай расправится с любым инакомыслием, каким бы оно ни было.
